_comment: Third-party material that is not an npm package (or is an npm package carrying a binary or data that needs its own notice). Curated by hand; read by tools/generate-notices.cjs (copied into THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.json) and by the About screen's credits (entries with credit: true). Keep in step with THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md; src/shared/__tests__/thirdPartyNotices.test.ts checks that every entry is named there.

components.name: JMdict (Japanese–English and Japanese–Russian)
components.trigger: Downloaded automatically on first start (Yomitan build by yomidevs/jmdict-yomitan) and stored compacted in the profile.
components.copyright: Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group (EDRDG)
components.attribution: This application uses the JMdict dictionary files. These files are the property of the Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group, and are used in conformance with the Group's licence (https://www.edrdg.org/edrdg/licence.html). JMdict is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International licence. Gum stores a compacted copy (definitions kept, glossary markup dropped).

components.name: KANJIDIC2 and JMnedict
components.trigger: Only when the learner imports the files themselves.
components.copyright: Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group (EDRDG)
components.attribution: KANJIDIC2 and JMnedict are the property of the Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group, and are used in conformance with the Group's licence (https://www.edrdg.org/edrdg/licence.html).

components.name: Moedict / Ministry of Education (Taiwan) Concise Mandarin Dictionary
components.trigger: Downloaded automatically on first start (Yomitan build by username-011/moe-dict-yomitan).
components.copyright: Ministry of Education, Republic of China (Taiwan)
components.attribution: 《國語辭典簡編本》, Ministry of Education, Republic of China (Taiwan), licensed CC BY-ND 3.0 Taiwan. Data via the g0v Moedict project (https://www.moedict.tw/).
components.notes: The repackaging repository declares no licence of its own. Gum downloads it on the learner's machine and does not redistribute it.

components.name: CC-CEDICT
components.trigger: Downloaded on request (Chinese). A copy under public/cedict is removed from the installer at package time.
components.attribution: CC-CEDICT, community maintained free Chinese-English dictionary. Published by MDBG (https://www.mdbg.net/). Licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International licence. Referenced works: CEDICT © 1997, 1998 Paul Andrew Denisowski.

components.trigger: Downloaded automatically on first start.
components.attribution: Pitch accent data from Kanjium by Uros O., licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.

components.name: Tatoeba example sentences
components.trigger: 706 grammar examples are compiled into the app; the full Japanese export downloads on request, and sentence search asks tatoeba.org when used.
components.attribution: Example sentences from the Tatoeba Project (https://tatoeba.org), licensed CC BY 2.0 FR. Each sentence keeps its Tatoeba ID.

components.name: Russian Wiktionary extract (kaikki.org / wiktextract)
components.trigger: Downloaded on request (Russian).
components.copyright: Wiktionary contributors; extraction by Tatu Ylonen (wiktextract)
components.attribution: Russian dictionary data from Wiktionary (https://www.wiktionary.org/) via wiktextract / kaikki.org, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL.

components.name: FrequencyWords (OpenSubtitles 2018), Chinese and Russian

components.attribution: Word frequency lists by Hermit Dave, FrequencyWords (OpenSubtitles 2018), content licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.
